title: Milk Mustache Song | Glug Glug Kids Rhyme for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A bouncy song about a glass of milk that says hello and helps us grow tall and strong.
See what happens when big brother says milk is boring, and how one big white mustache makes everyone laugh!
A fun way to help little ones enjoy their milk.

A glass of milk is smiling here
glug glug glug, it says hello
wiggle wiggle
milk is happy, let's all say so!

Glug glug, milk mustache
wiggle wiggle, look at me
glug, glug, glug, glug
milk mustache, one, two, three!

Brother says, "Milk is boring!"
he pushes the glass away
shove, shove, shove, shove
"No, no, no, no, I won't stay!"

Glug glug, milk mustache
wiggle wiggle, look at me
glug, glug, glug, glug
milk mustache, one, two, three!

The milk glass shows its strong white teeth
tall bones grow, grow, grow
tall, tall, tall
grow, grow, grow, as tall as Amma though!

Glug glug, milk mustache
wiggle wiggle, look at me
glug, glug, glug, glug
milk mustache, one, two, three!

Brother drinks it, glug, glug, glug
big white mustache on his face
ha, ha, ha, ha
Amma says, "Now that's the place!"
